name: Syndicate Assassins
summary: Southshore’s new magistrate suspects the Syndicate Assassins killed his predecessor. His clues point north of Tarren Mill, where he wants the gang slain.

sections.title: A Magistrate Murdered
sections.body:
Magistrate Henry Maleb now holds office in Southshore. The previous magistrate was assassinated, and the killers were never found. Maleb is almost certain the Syndicate hired them.

Thieves make up the gang, led by villainous nobles from the fallen kingdom of Alterac. Maleb’s last clues point north of Tarren Mill, which the Horde occupies. He asks you to slay the Syndicate members at the camp there.

faq.q: Why does Magistrate Henry Maleb want the Syndicate slain?
faq.answer: Southshore’s previous magistrate was assassinated, and the killers were never found. Magistrate Henry Maleb is almost certain the Syndicate hired them.
Villainous nobles from the fallen kingdom of Alterac lead the Syndicate, whose members are thieves.
The Syndicate camp lies north of Tarren Mill, which the Horde occupies. Maleb’s last clues led there.
